content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Project Technical Support-III Vacancy 2026 Details
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Three years graduate degree in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Food Technology, Food Science and Technology, Genetic Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Chemistry or Allied life sciences + three years post qualification experience. PG in Microbiology, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Food Technology, Food Science and Technology, Genetic Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Chemistry or Allied life sciences. Four years Graduate degree in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology & Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Biosciences and Bioengineering, Food Engineering/Technology, Pharmacy and allied disciplines. Desirable: Candidates should have knowledge in computational and experimental fields related to the project and publications in SCI/SCIE/Scopus.

content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the NIT Agartala recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the NIT Agartala recruitment is Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application for the NIT Agartala recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 28,000/- + HRA Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: The qualifications include a three-year graduate degree with three years of experience, a PG degree, or a four-year graduate degree in specified life sciences and engineering disciplines.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on a Walk-in Interview.
